title: test_multihop_latency_bounds.py: Edge case: zero min_us masks variance check
description: Line 260: When stats.min_us equals 0, the ratio defaults to 1.0 regardless of max_us value. This causes the assertion `ratio <= 2.0` to pass even when there is extreme latency variance (e.g., min=0, max=1000000 would yield ratio=1.0 instead of flagging the variance). Should either skip the assertion when min_us is 0, or use a different comparison method for this edge case.
close_reason: Variance check fails when min_us==0 instead of masking as ratio=1.0; RX is polled 1ms into airtime so min_us is a real hop latency.
